scope: Age/preparation compatibility and gene-holdout diagnostics, not new calibrated cell proportion estimates.
sources: Previously checked 20 sorted WT profiles from GSE158471, GSE232415 and GSE290629
age_reference_rules: GEO library accession, author sample table and barcode prefix must reconcile without expression-based relabeling.
Do not infer author cell type labels from scripts alone; absent per-cell labels remain absent.
Stream integer counts in two passes with bounded memory; do not allocate a full dense cell-by-gene matrix.

Record detected genes, count totals and mitochondrial fraction. Source-code QC bounds (500 < detected genes < 8000, 2000 < counts < 125000, mitochondrial fraction <15%) are a sensitivity branch, not inferred independent ground truth; upper bounds were confirmed during source inspection before reference fitting.
Compare both summed-count RNA pseudobulks and equal-cell normalized mean profiles; neither is unbiased in-vivo cell composition.
Ages are confounded with preparation/capture, and libraries are not verified independent animals. No inferential age p-values or cell-level pseudoreplication.
fixed_reference_rules: Reuse pooled original_4, centroid_4 and centroid_13 tables with their existing gene universe and no marker retuning.
Use shared genes and fixed inverse sqrt(centroid_4 mean + 1) weighting across all models.
Five deterministic gene folds from seed 20261024; fit on four folds and predict the fifth with no post-fit rescaling on held-out genes.
Report weighted and log2 holdout errors, fitted-weight ranges and design condition numbers; do not call errors proportion accuracy.
For 18 scored sorted profiles, retain prespecified broad labels; preL remains unscored; no winner selection based on agreement.
prior_results: Do not overwrite frozen eight-cohort, four-contrast expansion or Lrh1 follow-up outputs.
